why.risk_on: Macro trend is strong and meme activity on the XRPL is warm but not euphoric.
why.risk_on_late: Macro trend is strong but XRPL memes are in euphoria. Late-cycle conditions: consider taking profits.
why.neutral_early: Macro trend is strong but XRPL memes are still cold. Money hasn't reached the XRPL yet: watch for heat picking up.
why.neutral: Macro trend is mixed. No clear edge in either direction.
why.risk_off: Macro trend is weak. Protect capital until it recovers.
